question:
Select the word that is closest in meaning (SYNONYM) to the word given below.

Levitate
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Float'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **"levitate" **refers to the act of rising or floating in the air, especially in seeming defiance of gravity.
 
• The word** "float" **refers to remain or move on the surface of a liquid without sinking. (तैरना)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Float'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Laydown**: To put or place something in a particular position. (रखना)
 
• **Rusticate: **To send someone away from a university or school as a punishment. (विद्यालय से निष्कासित करना)
 
• **Walk**: To move on foot at a regular pace by lifting and setting down each foot in turn. (चलना)
